children: The basis of allotment for Mahanadi Coalfields Ltd.'s initial public offering (IPO) is scheduled to be finalised on Wednesday, November 25. Investors who subscribed to the issue can check their allotment status online through the registrar, KFin Technologies, or the BSE and NSE websites.

The ₹8,981.12-crore IPO garnered an overall subscription of 1.52 times by the close of bidding on November 23. Investors placed bids for approximately 74.87 crore shares against 49.31 crore shares on offer.

Demand was largely driven by qualified institutional buyers (QIBs), whose reserved portion was subscribed 4.95 times. The non-institutional investor (NII) category received bids for 66% of the shares reserved, while the retail investor portion was subscribed 46%.
The employee and Coal India shareholder categories saw subscription levels of 22% and 56%, respectively.
Mahanadi Coalfields IPO GMP

The grey market premium (GMP) for Mahanadi Coalfields IPO witnessed a sharp decline towards the close of the subscription period. According to InvestorGain, the last recorded GMP as of November 23 stood at zero.
The GMP is an unofficial indicator of market sentiment and is not a reliable guarantee of listing gains. It can change depending on market conditions and investor demand.
How to check Mahanadi Coalfields IPO allotment status on KFin Technologies
Investors can follow these steps to check their allotment status through the IPO registrar:
1. Visit the [KFin Technologies IPO allotment portal](https://ipostatus.kfintech.com/).
2. Select Mahanadi Coalfields from the list of IPOs, once available.
3. Choose an identification method, such as PAN, application number or DP/client ID.
4. Enter the relevant details and submit.
5. The allotment status will appear on the screen.
How to check Mahanadi Coalfields IPO allotment status on BSE
Investors can also check their application status through the BSE website:
1. Visit the [BSE IPO application status page](https://www.bseindia.com/investors/appli_check).
2. Select 'Equity' as the issue type.
3. Choose Mahanadi Coalfields from the list of IPOs.
4. Enter the application number or PAN, as required.
5. Submit the details to view the application status.
How to check Mahanadi Coalfields IPO bid details on NSE
Investors can verify their IPO bid details through the NSE website by following these steps:
1. Visit the [NSE IPO bid verification page](https://www.nseindia.in/invest/check-trades-bids-verify-ipo-bids).
2. Select Mahanadi Coalfields from the issue list.
3. Enter the required application details.
4. Submit the information to verify the bid.
5. The relevant bid details will be displayed on the screen.
Mahanadi Coalfields IPO: Issue details
Mahanadi Coalfields Ltd. (MCL), a wholly owned subsidiary of state-run Coal India Ltd., opened its IPO for subscription on November 19 and closed the issue on November 23.

Ahead of the public issue, the company raised ₹2,295.2 crore through its anchor book. Life Insurance Corporation of India (LIC) was the largest anchor investor, accounting for more than 26% of the total anchor allocation. Nippon Life India was another significant participant, investing nearly ₹500 crore.
The company fixed the IPO price band at ₹129–₹136 per share. Investors could apply for a minimum of 110 shares and in multiples thereof.
At the upper end of the price band, Mahanadi Coalfields was valued at approximately ₹90,009.74 crore, with the IPO size pegged at ₹8,981.12 crore.

The issue is entirely an offer for sale (OFS), through which Coal India is offloading 66.18 crore shares, representing a 10% stake in its subsidiary. Since the IPO does not include a fresh issue of shares, Mahanadi Coalfields will not receive any proceeds from the offering. The entire amount, after applicable expenses, will accrue to Coal India.
About Mahanadi Coalfields
Headquartered in Odisha, Mahanadi Coalfields accounted for 21% of India's total domestic coal production and 28.4% of Coal India's output in FY26.
Coal India, meanwhile, contributed around 74% of India's overall coal production during the financial year.
In March, the state-run mining company had indicated plans to divest up to 25% stakes in Mahanadi Coalfields and South Eastern Coalfields through IPOs or other routes.
For the financial year ended March 31, Mahanadi Coalfields reported a 1.3% year-on-year decline in net profit to ₹10,678 crore. Revenue fell 2.6% to ₹30,550 crore.
SBI Capital Markets, Axis Capital, BOB Capital Markets, IDBI Capital Markets & Securities and IIFL Capital Services are the merchant bankers managing the IPO.
Mahanadi Coalfields' equity shares are proposed to be listed on both the BSE and NSE.
